text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One early morning at summer camp…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzz… Bzzz…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing my phone vibrate, I take a look at the screen and answer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh! Morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sorry for ringing so early! I'm glad you're up, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Could you come out with me for a little while? I'd like to talk to you about something.
Seiun Sky ends up leading me to the beach. It's still quite early, so no one else is around.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No, get over that already. This is a secret tactical meeting! You do wanna come up with a strategy for the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hellooo? Would you quit giving me the cold shoulder?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I get it. It's not like me to call a tactical meeting.
choice_data_list: So why set one up all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …I really ran as hard as I could at the Satsuki Sho and the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I feel like if things keep going the way they are, I'm gonna hit my peak.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Nobody ever really expected a lot from me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm not getting all heavy or anything. I just mean I've always been the "what you see is what you get" type. Take a look.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is my adorable daintiness not getting across?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My point is… foisting all your expectations on a cutesy Umamusume like me is so cruel!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It was the same with Gramps. He kept praising me and saying I have what it takes to win the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So I came to Tracen and made my debut, but every day I'm surprised by all the things I'm lacking.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't have any kind of innate agility, or the competitive spirit to seize opportunities.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The stuff I don't have, that I can't have… I see all of them in everyone around me… Even so, I haven't maxed out my potential yet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wonder if all the people who've known me since I was little are super surprised right now.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I don't have what it takes, but here I am, competing against racers with real talent.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Still, there has to be a limit to that. There's only so much I can improve, and there's no closing the gap between my natural aptitude and theirs.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Spe and the others all believe that, by the end of summer, they'll be better than they were at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: …And I think they're right. If we faced off against each other seriously, I wouldn't be able to win.
choice_data_list: So what are you going to do?
So what are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What I'm gonna do… is run away from the fight. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't stand a chance against them directly! I'd just fall behind and get hopelessly trounced.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So… I won't race like they do. I'll force them to run at my pace instead.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: And then everyone will be like, "Whoa! When did Seiun Sky reach the winner's circle?!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You know, if I can get them to say something like that, it'll mean I pulled it off.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Flying ahead with high speed or pushing forward on raw power are cool and all, but…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My greatest ally is my smarts. I can control time itself when I put my mind to it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Haha! My talent? No way. Distractions, ploys, and traps are all just tricks.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But a well-laid trap actually gets results. For me, that's the only path to victory.
"Run from the fight, win the race." She can scope out a shot at victory by racing in a way that's all her own. That's a strength no other racer's got.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: All that's to say… I'm gonna need your brains.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: You don't have any training methods on how to smoothly hijack a race, do ya?
It's a reckless request, but if this is the Kikuka Sho we're talking about, then I do have some ideas.
choice_data_list: Strategy training to prepare for the third-corner hill.
Perseverance training to pull ahead in the last stretch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oho… You're right. Conquering that hill at Kyoto Racecourse could be the key.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But don't make me go running up any hundred-step shrine stairs! …Okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm serious! I won't do it!
Seiun Sky keeps spouting similar protests but trains diligently all the same.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh? Over there, is that… Sky?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I don't believe it. Since when did she start doing early morning sessions?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, both Special Week and Sky seem to be improving…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As one of the big three, I won't be left behind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Perseverance… Sounds tough. But I guess pushing through in the final, final stretch really is important.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But I can train for that by persevering away from practice, riiight? …Wrong?
Seiun Sky continues spouting similar protests, but trains diligently all the same.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh? Over there, is that… Sky?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I don't believe it. Since when did she start doing early morning sessions?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: So, both Special Week and Sky seem to be improving…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As one of the big three, I won't be left behind.
